user_query: I am organizing a workshop and need to send out email invitations to the participants. Can you validate the email addresses of the participants and provide me with the server status, syntax, and whether the emails are disposable or not? Additionally, check the MX records to ensure smooth email delivery.

TaskList.description: Collect a list of email addresses of all participants.
Validate the syntax of the email addresses to ensure they are correctly formatted.
Check the server status of each email address to confirm that the domain is operational.
Determine if the email addresses are disposable by checking against known disposable email providers.
Check the MX records for each email domain to ensure they can receive emails.
Compile all validation results in a report for the workshop invitations.
